actions.label: Open Infographic Builder in Recipe Gallery
actions.expected: The blank document reaches its built-in recipes through the ordinary Gallery command.

actions.label: Choose Infographic Builder
actions.expected: The versioned built-in recipe loads its real setup sheet and token-scoped fake-provider readiness through the application boundary.

actions.label: Preview Infographic Builder
actions.expected: The Gallery validates the current document artifact, exact call range, and token-scoped fake-provider substitutions before insertion.

actions.label: Insert Infographic Builder
actions.expected: The Gallery inserts the prepared built-in graph as one undoable ordinary UI transaction without starting provider work.

actions.label: Fit inserted recipe
actions.expected: The inserted recipe's cards and visible lanes fit the ordinary canvas viewport.

actions.label: Select Infographic Builder run root
actions.expected: The recipe's advertised run node is selected through its visible keyboard-focusable title even when a connection lane crosses the card.

actions.label: Preview Infographic Builder Branch
actions.expected: The exact recipe boundary, fake-provider bindings, and call count are visible before permission is granted.

actions.label: Start Infographic Builder reviewed plan
actions.expected: Only this immutable fake-provider recipe plan receives a one-use permit and starts.

actions.label: Wait for Infographic Builder human checkpoint
actions.expected: Job Center exposes the durable transition created through the reviewed recipe plan.

actions.label: Open Review for recipe checkpoint
actions.expected: Artifact Observatory exposes the durable human Compare checkpoint without an implicit model decision.

actions.label: Open recipe Compare stage
actions.expected: The recipe's sealed output candidates are reviewed by a person, not a model.

actions.label: Select recipe review candidate 1
actions.expected: The visible candidate is included in the explicit human checkpoint decision.

actions.label: Complete recipe human checkpoint
actions.expected: The selected output versions and review note are durably saved before downstream work resumes.

actions.label: Wait for the recipe to finish after human review
actions.expected: Job Center exposes the durable transition created through the reviewed recipe plan.

actions.label: Inspect Infographic Builder output
actions.expected: The recipe returns to its visible canvas with the fake-provider output persisted.

actions.label: Select Infographic Builder output node
actions.expected: The advertised fake-provider output is inspected on the inserted recipe itself.

actions.label: Capture Infographic Builder fake-provider output
actions.expected: This fresh-document recipe was configured, inserted, explicitly previewed, permitted, and completed through ordinary controls using only the recovery simulation.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Infographic Builder packaged recipe
actions.expected: The built-in workflow reaches its advertised fake-provider output from a fresh document through visible setup and run controls.
actions.actual: The journey inserted 4 recipe nodes, reviewed an immutable 2-call plan, and completed the durable result without any real provider.
